data.narrative: Learner demonstrated exemplary AI-augmented engineering discipline, architecting constraint-driven prompts that forced deterministic file citations, establishing a rigorous verification protocol, and disproving an overconfident agent hallucination using empirical CLI commands.

dimension_scores.observation: Constructed structured, multi-part discovery prompts requiring line-number citations, explicit distinction between facts and assumptions, and extension point mapping.
dimension_scores.evidence: Separate verified observations from unknowns or assumptions, and cite the relevant file paths and line ranges... Clearly label facts, inferences, and unknowns.

dimension_scores.observation: Systematically spot-checked agent claims against runtime module imports and automated test execution, creating a permanent trust audit record.
dimension_scores.evidence: Executed node -e on models/store.js and routes/index.js, node --test tests/starter.test.js, and captured evidence in progress/trust-audit.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Diagnosed root-cause failure mode (insufficient context) on first pass and generated an evidence-grounded re-prompt in a single iteration.
dimension_scores.evidence: Re-evaluate the workspace from the actual filesystem, not from assumptions. First inspect package.json, list files under src/ and tests/... do not claim application files are missing unless checks confirm it.

dimension_scores.observation: Articulated a mature trust-and-verify mental model, recognizing that LLM text generation must always yield to independent CLI execution for state and runtime proof.
dimension_scores.evidence: Prompt improvements give the agent better context... but they cannot prove that code runs or that a service is reachable. Those claims require independent checks; if evidence conflicts, evidence takes priority.

dimension_scores.observation: Delivered comprehensive architecture summary and extension points analysis while maintaining 100% test passing status across the workspace.
dimension_scores.evidence: Created progress/architecture-summary.md and progress/trust-audit.md with zero syntax, architectural, or logical errors.

strengths: Mastery of prompt constraint engineering, preventing hallucinations by demanding citations and separating facts from inferences
Uncompromising verification discipline that relies on executable terminal commands rather than conversational consensus
growth_areas: Apply this decomposition rigor to complex multi-entity state transitions and async audit logging in Module 02
data.recommendation: In Module 02, decompose the Team Collaboration feature into atomic prompt slices with explicit interface contracts and acceptance test assertions.

concepts_demonstrated: Hallucination detection via Test-Path and ripgrep

public_evidence.student_action: Directed AI agent to extract architectural baseline and extension points, verified models and routes via CLI probes, and disproved an overconfident claim.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Produced progress/architecture-summary.md and progress/trust-audit.md, verified node --test suites, and formulated constraint-based re-prompts.
public_evidence.proof: Executed node -e module exports and node --test (1 pass, 0 fail); documented disproved claim and corrected statement in trust-audit.md.
public_evidence.ability: Directs AI agents with constraint-driven prompts and validates system truth with automated CLI verification
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates the engineer does not blindly accept AI output, catching hallucinations and verifying architectural integrity before shipping.
